newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mbeki to lead trade visit to India.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mbeki to lead trade visit to India.

text.p: South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki will lead a trade mission to India from December 3, officials said on Thursday.

A spokesman said Mbeki, due back from a European mission on Tuesday, would leave for India on December 2 and return five days later. He will be accompanied by Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin and a South African business delegation.
A Trade and Industry department official said Mbeki and Erwin would attend an interministerial meeting chaired by South African Deputy Foreign Minister Aziz Pahad in Delhi.
He said they would meet bankers, industrialists and the governor of the Indian central bank in Bombay, Delhi and Bangalore and would discuss trade, defence and computer software development.
India and South Africa would conclude a treaty to avoid double taxation and an investment protection and promotion agreement.
Mbeki is widely regarded as President Nelson Mandela's heir apparent and has assumed overall responsibility for South Africa's macroeconomic policy development.
The official said Erwin would travel on to Singapore after the Indian visit for a meeting of World Trade Organisation ministers from December 9 to 13.
